messages:
Evan (CS): Heads-up — pulled together notes from three onboarding conversations this week. customers call out two recurring things: (1) API key rotation UX is confusing, (2) per-route cost visibility during trial is missing. Need quick prioritization and owners.
Priya (PM): Thanks Evan. Can you paste short verbatims? want to map to impact/effort.
Evan (CS): Sure — from Nebula Health: "can't find where to rotate keys without docs, blocked for security review". From Marketloom: "trial team abandoned because we couldn't show per-route spend — finance blocked purchase". From Atlas Retail: "prompt templates are fine but runtime errors during long prompts make us nervous".
Marta (Onboarding): Nebula also mentioned they tried the UI flow and landed on token limits page by accident. So discoverability is the issue, not just docs.
Priya (PM): Quick prioritization idea: bucket by revenue risk + unblock (A = renewal/close at risk, B = conversion friction, C = nice-to-have). Nebula = A, Marketloom = A, Atlas = B.
Leo (Eng): Implementation notes: API key rotation UX — likely 2 wks dev + 1 wk QA for a small dropdown/rotate flow + backend rotation endpoint. Per-route spend visibility — depends on analytics exposure, might be 3-4 wks to surface per-route metrics in trial UI. Runtime errors — need logs and maybe a guardrail/validation on long prompts, ~1-2 wks.
Priya (PM): Sounds like Nebula (API rotation) is low-ish effort + high impact -> prioritize. Marketloom per-route spend is higher effort but high impact for sales — escalate to roadmap. Atlas runtime validation could be a quick patch.
Evan (CS): Agree. Can we create three tickets? label them cs-received and include sample quotes. I'll assign Nebula to Marta for design validation.
Marta (Onboarding): I can mock a simpler rotate button and put it in Figma by Friday. I'll also add a short tooltip in the flow as temporary fix.
Leo (Eng): I'll scope backend rotation endpoint and add a spike ticket. tagging @eng-runtime for any breaking concerns.
Priya (PM): I'll make the strategy ticket for per-route spend and propose a pilot dashboard for trial orgs. Could use Redwood Optimize metrics as a baseline.
Evan (CS): cs-bot — can you generate a digest and attach to the customer records in Salesforce? include the verbatims and that we've scoped effort.
cs-bot: Generated digest: https://redwood.internal/cs/digest/1732509876 — added to SF contacts for Nebula Health, Marketloom, Atlas Retail.
Evan (CS): Next steps: Marta -> UI mock + tooltip, Leo -> spike ticket, Priya -> strategy ticket, Evan -> update CS notes + follow up with Nebula security reviewer. I'll ping again when tickets exist. :thumbsup:
Priya (PM): If anyone thinks differently on priority, speak up now. Otherwise I'll put Nebula API rotation as P0 and per-route spend as P1 for Q2 planning.
Leo (Eng): fine with that.
Marta (Onboarding): fine.
Evan (CS): Great — thanks team. I'll reach out to Nebula's security lead tomorrow and loop in support docs to avoid the discoverability gap. :raised_hands:
